action_items: Backend tests pass serially (8/8); the repository pytest.ini defaults to two xdist workers against one shared demo session, so the parallel invocation can race between reset/process operations.

checks.criterion: Live Run accepts a sample invoice and reveals Extraction, PO Matching, and Decision stages sequentially
checks.name: live-run-happy-path
checks.evidence: Playwright: clicked sample-invoice-happy-button; extraction, matching, and decision pipeline details reached Complete; decision-label=approve and reason code contains within tolerance.

checks.name: extraction-fields-method
checks.evidence: Playwright: extraction-results-card displayed vendor, invoice number, date, PO reference, total amount, and extraction-method-badge=Text layer.

checks.criterion: Decision rules are applied in order with readable reasons
checks.name: decision-rules-branches
checks.evidence: Playwright: Missing total displayed missing_data/flag and Over tolerance displayed amount_mismatch/flag with visible reason text.

checks.criterion: Split PO cumulative billing supports partial then completion
checks.name: split-po-completes
checks.evidence: Playwright: Split PO 1 of 2 displayed pending/partial; Split PO 2 of 2 displayed approve/within tolerance.

checks.criterion: OCR sample uses the OCR path
checks.name: scanned-ocr-path
checks.evidence: Playwright: Scanned / OCR displayed OCR fallback and completed matching/decision evidence.

checks.name: duplicate-resubmission-rejected
checks.evidence: Playwright: after happy approve, duplicate fixture displayed decision-label=reject, reason code duplicate, and resubmission reason.

checks.criterion: Dashboard shows session history and decision counts
checks.name: dashboard-history-counts
checks.evidence: Playwright: dashboard displayed all five summary cards and history row with INV-1001, Acme Corporation, $8,400.00.

checks.name: po-reference-data-visible
checks.evidence: Playwright: purchase order database and six seeded PO numbers PO-1001 through PO-1006 were visible.

checks.criterion: Live Run accepts a sample invoice and reveals Extraction, PO Matching, and Decision stages sequentially
checks.name: test_tscheck_happy.py::test_happy_processes
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/invoices/process with sample_key=happy returned 200; response decision=approve, reason_code=within_tolerance, matched PO=PO-1001.

checks.name: test_tscheck_extraction.py::test_extraction_fields_and_method
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/invoices/process returned 200; response contained expected extracted fields and extraction_method=text.

checks.criterion: Decision rules are applied in order with readable reasons
checks.name: test_tscheck_decisions.py::test_decision_order_branches
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/invoices/process returned 200 for missing-total and over-tolerance; responses were flag/missing_data and flag/amount_mismatch with reasons.

checks.criterion: Split PO cumulative billing supports partial then completion
checks.name: test_tscheck_split.py::test_split_po_progression
checks.evidence: Two HTTP POST /api/invoices/process calls returned 200; split responses were pending/partial then approve/within_tolerance with cumulative progress.

checks.criterion: OCR sample uses the OCR path
checks.name: test_tscheck_ocr.py::test_scanned_ocr_fallback
checks.evidence: HTTP POST /api/invoices/process with scanned returned 200; extraction_method=ocr and completed decision with reason.

checks.name: test_tscheck_duplicate.py::test_duplicate_rejected
checks.evidence: Two HTTP POST /api/invoices/process calls returned 200; second response was reject/duplicate with resubmission reason.

checks.criterion: Dashboard shows session history and decision counts
checks.name: test_tscheck_dashboard.py::test_dashboard_summary_and_history
checks.evidence: HTTP GET /api/invoices/summary and /api/invoices/history returned 200; summary approve/total and created invoice id were present.

checks.name: test_tscheck_pos.py::test_seeded_purchase_orders_visible
checks.evidence: HTTP GET /api/invoices/pos returned 200 with six seeded PO records PO-1001 through PO-1006.
